source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 2 (PDF 22-53), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Force and Motion) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The total distance travelled by a body is an example of a:
(Kisi jism ka tay kiya hua kul faasla (distance) kis qisam ki quantity hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kul faasla scalar (ghair-simti miqdaar) hai; is ke liye sirf magnitude (miqdaar) kaafi hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: calculating the total distance travelled (scalar)

blocks.prompt:
2 Scalars are physical quantities that are described by:
(Scalars aisi physical quantities hain jinhein kis cheez se bayan kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scalar sirf magnitude (miqdaar) se bayan hota hai, simt (direction) ka zikr nahi hota (2.1).

book_ref.quote: Scalars are physical quantities that are described solely by a magnitude

blocks.prompt:
3 A scalar quantity can be fully characterized by:
(Aik scalar quantity ko poori tarah kis cheez se bayan kiya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: aik number aur us ki unit
sirf aik number aur aik simt

blocks.explanation: Scalars ki koi simt nahi hoti; aik number aur us ki unit se poori tarah bayan ho jaate hain (2.1).

book_ref.quote: fully characterized by a single number and its associated unit

blocks.prompt:
4 Which one of the following is a scalar quantity?
(In mein se scalar quantity kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Speed (raftaar) scalar hai (2.1); velocity, displacement aur force vectors hain (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Speed: The rate at which an object covers distance.

blocks.prompt:
5 Temperature is a measure of the:
(Temperature (darja-e-hararat) kis cheez ka paimana hai?)

options.text: maadde ke zarraat ki average kinetic energy

blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq temperature maadde ke zarraat ki average kinetic energy (harkati tawanai) ka paimana hai (2.1).

book_ref.quote: Temperature: A measure of the average kinetic energy of particles in a substance.

blocks.prompt:
6 Which pair consists of scalar quantities only?
(Kaun sa jora sirf scalar quantities par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Energy aur time dono scalars ki list mein hain (2.1); force, acceleration aur velocity vectors hain (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Energy: The capacity to do work.

blocks.prompt:
7 Physical quantities that need both magnitude and direction for their complete specification are called:
(Woh physical quantities jinhein poori tarah bayan karne ke liye magnitude aur direction dono chahiye, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vectors (simti miqdaarein) ke liye magnitude aur direction dono zaroori hain (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Those physical quantities which have magnitude well as direction for their complete specification.

blocks.prompt:
8 The change in position of an object is called:
(Kisi jism ki position (maqam) mein tabdeeli ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Displacement (haqeeqi faasla) position mein tabdeeli hai; is ki magnitude aur simt dono hoti hain, maslan 10 m maghrib ki taraf (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Displacement: The change in position of an object.

blocks.prompt:
9 Acceleration is produced in a body when its velocity changes in:
(Jism mein acceleration (asraa) tab paida hota hai jab us ki velocity mein kis cheez ki tabdeeli ho?)
blocks.explanation: Acceleration velocity ki tabdeeli ki sharah hai; yeh tabdeeli speed ya direction ya dono mein ho sakti hai (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Acceleration: The rate of change of velocity that occurs in either speed or direction or both

blocks.prompt:
10 In a vector diagram, the length of the arrow represents the vector's:
(Vector diagram mein teer (arrow) ki lambai vector ki kis cheez ko zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teer ki lambai magnitude (miqdaar) batati hai aur us ka sir (head) direction batata hai (2.2).

book_ref.quote: The length of the arrows indicates the magnitude

blocks.prompt:
11 In print, a vector is usually denoted by:
(Chhapai mein vector ko aam tor par kaise likha jata hai?)

options.text: bold harf ya symbol ke oopar teer ka nishan

blocks.explanation: Vector ko bold face harf (V, F) ya symbol ke oopar teer ke nishan se likhte hain (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Vectors are typically denoted by bold face letters

blocks.prompt:
12 The effective value of a vector in a given direction is called its:
(Kisi diye gaye rukh mein vector ki moassar (effective) qeemat ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi rukh mein vector ki effective qeemat us ka component (juz) hai (2.2).

book_ref.quote: A component of a vector is its effective value in a given direction.

blocks.prompt:
13 Components of a vector along mutually perpendicular directions are called:
(Aapas mein amoodi (perpendicular) rukhon mein vector ke components kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aapas mein amoodi rukhon ke components rectangular components kehlate hain (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Such components are called rectangular components.

blocks.prompt:
14 A vector A makes an angle θ with the x-axis. Its x-component is:
(Vector A x-axis ke saath θ angle banata hai. Is ka x-component kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Qaima zaviya tikon (right-angled triangle) OMP se Ax = A cos θ aur Ay = A sin θ (Eqs. 2.2, 2.3).

book_ref.quote: Considering the right angled triangle OMP

blocks.prompt:
15 A force of 20 N acts at 30° to the x-axis. Its y-component is:
(20 N ki force x-axis se 30° par amal karti hai. Is ka y-component kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fy = F sin θ = 20 N × sin 30° = 10 N (Eq. 2.3). 17.3 N x-component hai.

book_ref.quote: the magnitude of A⃗y or y-component of A⃗ is:

blocks.prompt:
16 A force of 20 N acts at 30° to the x-axis. Its x-component is:
(20 N ki force x-axis se 30° par amal karti hai. Is ka x-component kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fx = F cos θ = 20 N × cos 30° = 17.3 N (Eq. 2.2).

book_ref.quote: Considering the right angled triangle OMP, the magnitude of A⃗x

blocks.prompt:
17 The rectangular components of a vector are Ax = 6 units and Ay = 8 units. Its magnitude is:
(Aik vector ke rectangular components Ax = 6 units aur Ay = 8 units hain. Is ki magnitude kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: we can find out the magnitude of the vector by using Pythagorean Theorem

blocks.prompt:
18 For the vector with Ax = 6 units and Ay = 8 units, the angle with the x-axis is about:
(Jis vector ke Ax = 6 units aur Ay = 8 units hain, us ka x-axis se angle taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The direction θ is given by

blocks.prompt:
19 Two forces of equal magnitude F have a resultant of magnitude √3 F. The angle between them is:
(Barabar magnitude F wali do forces ka resultant √3 F hai. Un ke darmiyan angle kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Example 2.1 ki tarah: R² = 2F² + 2F² cos θ. R² = 3F² rakhne se cos θ = 0.5, is liye θ = 60°.

book_ref.quote: Find the angle between two forces of equal magnitude

blocks.prompt:
20 The angle between the two rectangular components of a vector is:
(Kisi vector ke do rectangular components ke darmiyan angle kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rectangular components aapas mein qaima zaviya (90°) par hote hain (2.2).

book_ref.quote: Since these are at right angle to each other

blocks.prompt:
21 If the product of two vectors results in a vector quantity, the product is called:
(Agar do vectors ki zarb (product) ka nateeja vector ho to is product ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jis product ka nateeja scalar ho woh scalar product, aur jis ka nateeja vector ho woh vector product hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: if the product of two vectors results in a vector quantity then it is called vector product

blocks.prompt:
22 The scalar product of A and B is defined as:
(A aur B ka scalar product kis tarah define hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: A.B = AB cos θ, jahan θ dono vectors ke darmiyan angle hai (Eq. 2.6).

book_ref.quote: where A and B are the magnitudes of vectors A⃗ and B⃗ and θ is the angle between them

blocks.prompt:
23 Physically, A.B equals A multiplied by:
(Tabeei (physical) tor par A.B, A ko kis cheez se zarb dene ke barabar hai?)

options.text: B ka A par amoodi component

blocks.explanation: A.B = A (B ka A par projection (saya)) = A(B cos θ) (2.3, Fig. 2.2).

book_ref.quote: these are first brought to a common origin

blocks.prompt:
24 A force of 50 N moves its point of application 10 m in a direction at 60° to the force. The work done is:
(50 N ki force apne point of application ko force se 60° ke rukh mein 10 m le jati hai. Kaam (work) kitna hua?)

book_ref.quote: We come across this type of product when we consider the work done by a force

blocks.prompt:
25 Two vectors of magnitudes 4 units and 5 units make an angle of 60°. Their scalar product is:
(4 units aur 5 units magnitude ke do vectors 60° ka angle banate hain. Un ka scalar product kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: A.B = AB cos θ = 4 × 5 × 0.5 = 10 units (Eq. 2.6).

book_ref.quote: The scalar product of two vectors A⃗ and B⃗ is written as A⃗.B⃗

blocks.prompt:
26 Since A.B = B.A, the scalar product is:
(Chunke A.B = B.A hai, is liye scalar product kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zarb ki tarteeb se farq nahi parta, is liye scalar product commutative (tabaadli) hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: The order of multiplication is irrelevant.

blocks.prompt:
27 The scalar product of two mutually perpendicular vectors is:
(Do aapas mein amoodi (perpendicular) vectors ka scalar product kitna hota hai?)

book_ref.quote: The scalar product of two mutually perpendicular vectors (θ = 90°) is zero.

blocks.prompt:
28 For two antiparallel vectors A and B, the scalar product is:
(Do mukhalif-mutawazi (antiparallel) vectors A aur B ka scalar product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: θ = 180° par A.B = AB cos 180° = -AB (2.3).

book_ref.quote: For antiparallel vectors (θ = 180°)

blocks.prompt:
29 The self product A.A of a vector is equal to:
(Kisi vector ka self product A.A kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: A.A = AA cos 0° = A², yani magnitude ka murabba (square) (2.3).

book_ref.quote: The self product of a vector A⃗ is equal to square of its magnitude.

blocks.prompt:
30 Two parallel vectors have magnitudes 3 units and 7 units. Their scalar product is:
(Do mutawazi (parallel) vectors ki magnitudes 3 units aur 7 units hain. Un ka scalar product kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mutawazi vectors ke liye θ = 0°, is liye A.B = AB = 3 × 7 = 21 units (2.3). -21 antiparallel ke liye hota.

book_ref.quote: The scalar product of two parallel vectors is equal to the product of their magnitudes.

blocks.prompt:
31 Two vectors have rectangular components Ax = 3, Ay = 4, Az = 0 and Bx = 4, By = -3, Bz = 0. The angle between them is:
(Do vectors ke rectangular components Ax = 3, Ay = 4, Az = 0 aur Bx = 4, By = -3, Bz = 0 hain. Un ke darmiyan angle kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Scalar product of two vectors A⃗ and B⃗ in terms of their rectangular components

blocks.prompt:
32 In A × B = AB sin θ n̂, the unit vector n̂ is:
(A × B = AB sin θ n̂ mein unit vector n̂ kaisa hai?)

options.text: A aur B wale plane par amoodi
A aur B ke darmiyani khat (bisector) par

blocks.explanation: n̂ aik unit vector hai jo A aur B wale plane (satah) par amoodi hai (Eq. 2.9).

book_ref.quote: is a unit vector perpendicular to the plane containing A⃗ and B⃗

blocks.prompt:
33 The direction of the vector product A × B is found by:
(Vector product A × B ki simt kis tarah maloom ki jati hai?)

options.text: right hand rule (daayen haath ka qaida)

blocks.explanation: Product vector ki simt right hand rule (daayen haath ka qaida) se maloom hoti hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: Its direction can be determined by right hand rule.

blocks.prompt:
34 In the right hand rule, the first vector A is rotated into B through:
(Right hand rule mein pehle vector A ko B ki taraf kis angle se ghumaya jata hai?)

options.text: do mumkin angles mein se bare angle se
do mumkin angles mein se chhote angle se

blocks.explanation: A ko B ki taraf chhote angle se ghumayein; seedha angootha (thumb) A × B ki simt deta hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: through the smaller of the two possible angles

blocks.prompt:
35 Compared with A × B, the vector B × A is:
(A × B ke muqable mein vector B × A kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Simt ke qaide se B × A, A × B ke ulat hai, yani A × B = -B × A (Eq. 2.10).

book_ref.quote: is a vector opposite in sign to A⃗ x B⃗

blocks.prompt:
36 Because A × B ≠ B × A, the cross product is:
(Chunke A × B ≠ B × A, is liye cross product kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: A × B aur B × A barabar nahi, is liye cross product non-commutative (ghair-tabaadli) hai (2.3).

book_ref.quote: the cross product is non commutative

blocks.prompt:
37 The magnitude of A × B is maximum when the angle between A and B is:
(A × B ki magnitude sab se zyada kab hoti hai jab A aur B ke darmiyan angle ho:)
blocks.explanation: θ = 90° par sin θ sab se bara (1) hai, is liye A × B = AB n̂ (2.3).

book_ref.quote: The cross product of two perpendicular vectors (θ = 90°) has maximum magnitude

blocks.prompt:
38 The cross product of a vector with itself, A × A, is:
(Kisi vector ka apne aap se cross product A × A kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mutawazi vectors ke liye θ = 0°, is liye A × A = 0, yani null vector (2.3).

book_ref.quote: The cross product of two parallel vectors is null vector

blocks.prompt:
39 The magnitude of A × B is equal to the:
(A × B ki magnitude kis ke barabar hai?)

options.text: A aur B mutasil sides wale parallelogram ka area
us parallelogram ke diagonal ki lambai

blocks.explanation: |A × B| us parallelogram (mutawazi-ul-azla) ke area ke barabar hai jis ke do mutasil (adjacent) sides A aur B hain (2.3).

book_ref.quote: is equal to the area of the parallelogram formed with A⃗ and B⃗

blocks.prompt:
40 Two adjacent sides of a parallelogram are vectors of 5 cm and 8 cm with 30° between them. Its area is:
(Aik parallelogram ke do mutasil sides 5 cm aur 8 cm ke vectors hain aur un ke darmiyan 30° hai. Is ka area kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: As a consequence A⃗ x A⃗ = 0 (θ = 0°)

blocks.prompt:
41 Two vectors of 3 units and 4 units make an angle of 30°. The magnitude of their vector product is:
(3 units aur 4 units ke do vectors 30° ka angle banate hain. Un ke vector product ki magnitude kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: |A × B| = AB sin θ = 3 × 4 × 0.5 = 6 units (Eq. 2.9).

book_ref.quote: The vector product of two vectors A⃗ and B⃗, is a vector which is defined as

blocks.prompt:
42 If |A × B| = A.B / √3, the angle between A and B is:
(Agar |A × B| = A.B / √3 ho to A aur B ke darmiyan angle kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: AB sin θ = AB cos θ / √3 se tan θ = 1/√3, is liye θ = 30° (Eqs. 2.6, 2.9).

book_ref.quote: The direction of the product vector is perpendicular to this plane.

blocks.prompt:
43 The torque τ produced by a force F acting at position vector r is given by:
(Position vector r par amal karne wali force F ka torque τ kis tarah diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Torque (gardishi asar) r aur F ka vector product hai: τ = r × F (2.3).

book_ref.quote: the turning effect of the force called the torque

blocks.prompt:
44 The force on a charge q moving with velocity v in a magnetic field B is:
(Magnetic field B mein velocity v se harkat karte charge q par force kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Magnetic force v aur B ka vector product hai: F = q(v × B) (2.3).

book_ref.quote: in a magnetic field of strength B⃗ is given by vector product

blocks.prompt:
45 A force of 20 N acts perpendicular to a position vector of 0.5 m from the axis of rotation. The magnitude of the torque is:
(20 N ki force gardish ke mehwar (axis) se 0.5 m ke position vector par amoodi amal karti hai. Torque ki magnitude kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: When a force F⃗ is applied on a rigid body at a point

blocks.prompt:
46 The equations of motion can be applied only to objects moving:
(Equations of motion (harkat ki masawaat) sirf un ajsaam par lagti hain jo kaise harkat kar rahe hon?)

options.text: seedhi line mein mustaqil acceleration ke saath
daire mein mustaqil speed ke saath
seedhi line mein badalte acceleration ke saath
kisi bhi raaste par kisi bhi acceleration ke saath

blocks.explanation: Yeh masawaat sirf seedhi line mein mustaqil (constant) acceleration wali harkat par lagti hain (2.4).

book_ref.quote: These equations of motion can only be applied to those objects which are moving in a straight line with constant acceleration.

blocks.prompt:
47 The three kinematic variables used in the equations of motion are:
(Equations of motion mein istemal hone wale teen kinematic variables kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh masawaat harkat ko velocity (v), position (s) aur time (t) ki shakal mein bayan karti hain (2.4).

book_ref.quote: three kinematic variables: velocity (v), position (s) and time (t)

blocks.prompt:
48 The third equation of motion relates the pair:
(Teesri equation of motion kis jore ko jorti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Velocity-time, position-time aur velocity-position tarteeb se pehli, doosri aur teesri equation hain (2.4).

book_ref.quote: In this order they are called first equation of motion, second equation of motion and third equation of motion

blocks.prompt:
49 A body moving at 5 m s⁻¹ accelerates uniformly at 3 m s⁻² for 4 s. Its final velocity is:
(5 m s⁻¹ se chalta jism 4 s tak 3 m s⁻² se yaksaan (uniform) acceleration karta hai. Us ki final velocity kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: It correlates the final velocity attained by a body with initial velocity and the time interval t

blocks.prompt:
50 In the velocity-time graph of uniformly accelerated motion, the slope of the line gives the:
(Yaksaan acceleration wali harkat ke velocity-time graph mein line ka slope (dhalaan) kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Line AB ka slope BC/AC acceleration a ke barabar hai (2.4).

book_ref.quote: by taking the slope of line AB, Which is equal to acceleration a

blocks.prompt:
51 In the graphical derivation of the second equation of motion, the displacement equals the area of:
(Doosri equation ki graph wali derivation mein displacement kis area ke barabar hai?)

options.text: velocity-time graph ke neeche rectangle jama triangle

blocks.explanation: S = area OABD = rectangle OACD ka area + triangle ABC ka area (2.4).

book_ref.quote: Second equation of motion can be derived using velocity-time graph

blocks.prompt:
52 When the velocity of a body is not constant, displacement is found by multiplying time with the:
(Jab jism ki velocity mustaqil na ho to displacement nikalne ke liye time ko kis se zarb dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Velocity mustaqil na ho to displacement = average (ausat) velocity × time (2.4).

book_ref.quote: If velocity of the body is not constant, we can use average velocity instead of velocity.

blocks.prompt:
53 A body starts at 12 m s⁻¹ and reaches 20 m s⁻¹ in 6 s with uniform acceleration. The distance covered is:
(Aik jism 12 m s⁻¹ se chal kar yaksaan acceleration se 6 s mein 20 m s⁻¹ tak pohanchta hai. Tay kiya gaya faasla kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Let it covers a distance S in a particular direction during time t

blocks.prompt:
54 A car moving at 8 m s⁻¹ accelerates at 2 m s⁻² for 5 s. The distance it covers is:
(8 m s⁻¹ se chalti car 5 s tak 2 m s⁻² se acceleration karti hai. Woh kitna faasla tay karti hai?)

book_ref.quote: Suppose a body is moving with uniform acceleration a along a straight line

blocks.prompt:
55 In the graphical derivation of the third equation, the area OABD under the velocity-time graph is treated as a:
(Teesri equation ki graph wali derivation mein velocity-time graph ke neeche area OABD ko kya samjha jata hai?)

options.text: trapezium: ½ (mutawazi sides ka majmua) × unchai

blocks.explanation: S = ½ (OA + BD) × OD, yani ½ (mutawazi sides ka majmua) × unchai (2.4).

book_ref.quote: the total distance S travelled by a body is given by the area OABD under the graph

blocks.prompt:
56 A car starts from rest and reaches 72 km h⁻¹ after covering 100 m with uniform acceleration. Its acceleration is:
(Aik car sakoon (rest) se chal kar 100 m tay karne ke baad 72 km h⁻¹ tak pohanchti hai. Us ka acceleration kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: vf = 72 km h⁻¹ = 20 m s⁻¹. 2aS = vf² - vi² se a = 400/200 = 2 m s⁻² (Eq. 2.16).

book_ref.quote: Consider a body moving along a straight line with an initial velocity vi

blocks.prompt:
57 A car moving at 20 m s⁻¹ is brought to rest by a uniform retardation of 4 m s⁻². The distance covered before stopping is:
(20 m s⁻¹ se chalti car ko 4 m s⁻² ki yaksaan retardation (kami) se roka jata hai. Rukne se pehle woh kitna faasla tay karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: a = -4 m s⁻² (vi ke ulat). 2(-4)S = 0 - 400, is liye S = 50 m (Eq. 2.16).

book_ref.quote: A negative sign is assigned to quantities where direction is opposite to that of initial velocity.

blocks.prompt:
58 In solving straight-line problems with the equations of motion, the direction of the initial velocity is taken as:
(Equations of motion se seedhi line ke sawal hal karte waqt initial velocity ki simt ko kya liya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Initial velocity ko positive liya jata hai; us ke ulat quantities ko negative nishan diya jata hai (2.4).

book_ref.quote: In such cases initial velocity is taken as positive.

blocks.prompt:
59 The average value of the acceleration due to gravity at the Earth's surface is taken as:
(Zameen ki satah par acceleration due to gravity (kashish-e-saql ka asraa) ki average qeemat kitni li jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: g ki average qeemat 9.8 m s⁻² neeche ki taraf li jati hai (2.4).

book_ref.quote: its average value at the Earth surface is taken as 9.8 ms⁻² in the downward direction

blocks.prompt:
60 A speed of 108 km h⁻¹ expressed in m s⁻¹ is:
(108 km h⁻¹ ki speed m s⁻¹ mein kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: 108 × 1000 m / 3600 s = 30 m s⁻¹ (Example 2.4 wala tareeqa).

book_ref.quote: In a short distance race, a contestant in a car starts from rest

blocks.prompt:
61 A body falling freely under gravity is the most familiar example of:
(Gravity ke tehat azadana girta jism kis ki sab se aam misaal hai?)

options.text: seedhi line mein yaksaan acceleration wali harkat

blocks.explanation: Azadana girna seedhi line mein yaksaan acceleration wali harkat ki sab se aam misaal hai (2.5).

book_ref.quote: the most familiar example of uniformly accelerated rectilinear motion

blocks.prompt:
62 In vacuum, a heavy stone and a light coin are dropped together from the same height. They strike the ground with:
(Khala (vacuum) mein aik bhaari pathar aur halka sikka aik hi unchai se saath giraye jaate hain. Woh zameen se kis velocity se takrate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khala mein sab ajsaam aik hi g se girte hain, is liye aik hi unchai se aik hi velocity se zameen par pohanchte hain (2.5).

book_ref.quote: different bodies, when allowed to fall from the same height, strike the ground with the same velocity

blocks.prompt:
63 In the chapter's sign rule, g is taken negative for a body that is:
(Chapter ke nishan wale qaide mein g kis jism ke liye negative liya jata hai?)

options.text: mez par ufuqi (horizontal) chal raha ho

blocks.explanation: Girte jism (vi = 0) ke liye g positive aur seedha oopar phainke gaye jism ke liye negative hai (2.5).

book_ref.quote: negative for a body projected vertically upward

blocks.prompt:
64 A stone is dropped from rest. Its velocity after 2.5 s is:
(Aik pathar sakoon se giraya jata hai. 2.5 s baad us ki velocity kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The equations of motion for a freely falling body, on putting a = g, become

blocks.prompt:
65 A stone dropped from rest falls for 2.5 s. The distance it falls is about:
(Sakoon se giraya gaya pathar 2.5 s tak girta hai. Woh taqreeban kitna faasla girta hai?)

book_ref.quote: Its experimental value is 9.8 m s⁻² in SI units.

blocks.prompt:
66 A ball is dropped from a height of 122.5 m. The time it takes to reach the ground is:
(Aik gend 122.5 m ki unchai se giraayi jati hai. Zameen tak pohanchne mein kitna waqt lagta hai?)

book_ref.quote: This means that different bodies, when allowed to fall from the same height

blocks.prompt:
67 A ball is thrown vertically upward at 19.6 m s⁻¹. The maximum height it reaches is:
(Aik gend 19.6 m s⁻¹ se seedhi oopar phainki jati hai. Woh zyada se zyada kitni unchai tak jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se oopar vf = 0 aur g = -9.8 m s⁻². 0 - 19.6² = 2(-9.8)h, is liye h = 19.6 m (2.5).

book_ref.quote: As regards the sign of g, it is taken positive for a falling body

blocks.prompt:
68 A ball thrown vertically upward at 19.6 m s⁻¹ reaches its highest point after:
(19.6 m s⁻¹ se seedhi oopar phainki gayi gend kitni der mein sab se oonche nuqte par pohanchti hai?)
